description: Reference case: k-means clustering of NW Mexico LFOs on CA scores from conapesca-lfo-ca (2001–2010, nombre_especie). Expected to produce k regions consistent with Erisman et al. (2011) when k=8, with industrial ports (Ensenada, Mazatlán, Guaymas) separated from regional clusters.

reference_case.comparison_note: Erisman et al. (2011) used Statistica v4.5 k-means on CANOCO CA scores; direct numerical comparison not possible. Verify qualitative consistency: industrial ports cluster separately, 5 geographic regions emerge.

note: Do not fill expected_lookup with skill output. Only mark VERIFIED after human review against an independent k-means run on the same CA scores.
